data.title: 奥萝拉 · 星穹回廊的赤足戏水
data.description: 远古圣域悬浮星海的白石回廊中央，清澈水幕倒映着浩瀚星云。身穿露背天衣的奥萝拉赤足踏入浅水，回眸伸出纤细手指，妩媚又落寞。
data.location: floating ancient sanctuary colonnade over a vast cosmic nebula reflecting pool
data.action: walking barefoot in shallow reflective water, glancing over bare shoulder while beckoning with a slender finger, mesmerizing enigmatic smile
data.lighting: 星云漫射紫青柔光与水面粼粼反光
data.promptProse: Witch Aurora glides barefoot across a cosmic reflecting pool in a backless gown, glancing over her shoulder with an enigmatic, beckoning smile.
data.animaCaption: Nebula reflections ripple beneath her bare feet as she beckons softly.
